evidence.quote: Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2

notes: The programme page is a Parcoursup fiche for French/EU Bac holders: the only tuition figure given ("Par année 178 euros") is the EU/EEA rate and no non-EU differentiated fee is stated for this programme, so tuition is left out. The 1 October–15 November 2026 application window on the Campus France Maroc page describes ADIUT Maroc candidature for Moroccan Bac holders via Études en France, not this Saint-Etienne IUT programme, and the Parcoursup page confirms non-EU foreign-diploma applicants must not use Parcoursup, so intake dates are left out. No document list is given.
